samples.title: The wind you felt this morning
samples.subject: Geography
samples.script: That cold wind on your walk to school this morning - it was not random. Air is lazy: it slides from where pressure is high to where pressure is low, like water finding the door. On the weather map, those curved lines are pressure lines. Squeezed close together? The slope is steep and the wind runs hard - that is what you felt. Far apart, calm day. Read the map like the ground under your feet: find the high, find the low, and the whole journey of the wind is written between them.
